# porkbun_domain_auto_renew_setting (Resource)

Update the auto-renew setting for one domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porkbun_domain_auto_renew_setting" "example" {
  domain     = "jiancodes.com"
  auto_renew = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Auto-renew status to set.
- `domain` (String) The domain to update the auto-renew setting for.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porkbun_domain_auto_renew_setting.example <domain>

terraform import porkbun_domain_auto_renew_setting.example jiancodes.com
```
